name: TMD Energy Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: TMD Energy Limited, an investment holding entity, centers its operations on delivering marine fuel bunkering solutions across key Southeast Asian and East Asian maritime hubs, specifically Hong Kong, Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, and Vietnam. The company specializes in the marketing and distribution of various marine fuels, including high-sulfur fuel oil, low-sulfur fuel oil, and very low-sulfur fuel oil, as well as marine gas, to the shipping industry. Beyond its core fuel supply business, TMD Energy diversifies its service portfolio to encompass vessel chartering and comprehensive ship management for both its own and external fleets. Additional offerings include the sale of cargo oil and potable water, alongside general vessel cleaning and disinfection services. Operating with a fleet of 15 meticulously maintained bunkering vessels, TMD Energy Limited was established in 2023 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It operates as a subsidiary of Straits Energy Resources Berhad.
